_comment: A shelf holds projects without being one. Everything directly below a shelf is a project; anything deeper becomes a breadcrumb (acme > tiroir).
_zoom: Base scale of the page. Set this instead of zooming in the browser every time; keep the browser itself at 100% or the two multiply.
_overrides: names: your label for a project, keyed by its resolved name. lines: your text for a session, keyed by sessionId — it also retitles that terminal tab. pinned: projects held at the top, in this order.
_stuck: A busy session whose transcript has been silent this many minutes is stuck. A `waiting` session is flagged at once, whatever this says.
_long_tool: While a tool call is running the transcript is silent, so silence proves nothing. Only a call outstanding this many minutes is worth mentioning, and it is shown as news, not as an alarm.
_waiting: A helper spawned by /btw sits in `waiting` for a few seconds. Only a question left unanswered this long is worth flagging.
_chime: Sound: a two-stroke chime when a session starts waiting on you, a single short tick when one finishes. Either sounds once, for whoever has just changed -- never for the ones already on screen when the page opens.
